course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Implement the following Boolean functions with NAND gates by means of Block (09) Diagram method.
(i) $F = B ( A C + D ) + A D ^ { \prime }$
(ii) $F = ( A + B D ^ { \prime } ) ( C D + E ^ { \prime } ; )$
Both the normal and complement inputs are available.
